title: UI风格#125 - Retro Arcade 80s (复古街机80年代)
description: 创建第125种UI风格：复古街机80年代风格 - 像素游戏、霓虹灯光、 arcade cabinet。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDU.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade 80s style When color palette Then features neon pink, electric blue, black, chrome yellow
Given Retro Arcade 80s style When typography Then uses pixel fonts: Press Start 2P, VT323, orsilkscreen
Given Retro Arcade 80s style When layout Then pixel grid, arcade cabinet frame, high score table, CRT screen curves
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: CRT scanline overlay, neon gradient border with glow, arcade cabinet aesthetic, dark purple/black background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade 80s style When UI elements Then pixel art, screen glow, joystick movement, coin insert
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: blink animation on header, CRT scanline overlay, neon glow box-shadows, pixel font typography

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade 80s UI When functional Then includes arcade chat, gamer agents, score stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: high scores chat, 4 gamer agents (Pixel/Bits/PRO/NOOB) with SCORE/LEVEL/LIVES/POWER/RANK/HI-SCORE/COINS/SKILL stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade 80s UI When copy Then uses arcade language: 'Insert', 'Coin', 'Player', 'Score'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'INSERT COIN. PLAYER ONE.', tagline '* INSERT COIN *', button 'PLAY', greeting 'PLAYER ONE READY - PRESS START', status 'PLAYING'/'GAME OVER', nav 'ARCADE'/'REPAIR'/'SCORES'/'HALL OF FAME'
